# CoCache

> Two-level distributed coherent cache for Java/Kotlin on Spring Boot 4: bounded local Caffeine (L2) in front of shared Redis (L1) in front of a data source. Redis serializes writes per key (lease-fenced fills), invalidations are deleted and broadcast over Redis Pub/Sub in one Lua script (a separate publish in sharded or non-atomic channel mode), and staleness is bounded. Maven group `me.ahoo.cocache`; JDK 21+; Redis 7.0+ (or Valkey 7.2+); packages `me.ahoo.cocache.*`.

Pick the type by one question: if Redis loses this key, can this process rebuild it? Yes: `Cache<K, V>` (with a `CacheLoader`, or `externallySourced()` / `@CoCache(source = EXTERNAL)` when callers such as Spring Cache supply the values) or `VersionedCache<K, V>` (versioned loader, `putIfNewer`). No: `Store<K, V>`, `VersionedStore<K, V>` or `SetStore<K, E>`, which hold the only copy in Redis and have no loader. Each type has only the operations safe for its role; all read through `get` / `getAll` / `lookup` (`Lookup.Present`, `Absent` or `Unknown`) and have `async()` and `suspending()` views.

Declare a cache as an interface (`@CoCache interface UserCache : Cache<String, User>`) registered with `@EnableCoCache(caches = [...])`, or as a spec bean (`@Bean fun userSpec(): CacheSpec<String, User> = cacheSpec("user") { ... }`, injected as `Cache<String, User>`); libraries create caches through the `CoCacheFactory` bean and lock the fields they depend on. Provide a `CacheLoader<K, V>` bean that loads on a miss (`null` = negative entry for `absentTtl`). Write pattern: commit the data source first, then `invalidate(key)` (inside a transaction, use `TransactionalInvalidator`). Configuration has three layers merged field by field: `cocache.defaults.cache.*` / `.store.*` below the declaration, `cocache.overrides.*` that only tighten, and `cocache.caches.[name].*`; every duration needs a unit, with the sentinels `forever`, `off` and `unlimited`.

## Docs

- [Why CoCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/): the problem, guarantees, limits, and when not to use it
- [Quick Start](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/quick-start): dependency, `@EnableCoCache` + `@CoCache` interface + `CacheLoader` bean, read, invalidate after commit; `cocache.backend: memory` without Redis; plain `CacheRuntime` without Spring
- [How It Works](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/concepts): two levels, read path, negative caching, refresh-ahead, write path, staleness bounds, failure behavior
- [Choosing and Declaring Caches](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/caches): the type-choice question and the five types, `@CoCache` / `@CaffeineCache` attributes, spec beans (Kotlin DSL, Java builder), storage keys and `KeyEncoder`, `ttlOf`, `KeyFilter`, `Lookup.Unknown` and `unknownRead`, codecs, default policy per type, `CoCacheFactory`, `CacheSpecCustomizer`, startup validation
- [Cache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/cache): derived copies with a loader or externally sourced, per-call loaders, `put` vs `invalidate`, behavior when Redis fails
- [VersionedCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/versioned-cache): versioned loaders, `putIfNewer` / `invalidateIfNewer`, `evict` and `purge`, refresh-ahead
- [Store](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/store): data whose only copy is Redis, synchronous deletes, conditional writes (`getIfChanged`, `putIfMatch`, `deleteIfMatch`), defaults and durability
- [VersionedStore](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/versioned-store): only-copy data with ordered writes, `putIfNewer` / `deleteIfNewer`, tombstones and `purge`
- [SetStore](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/set-store): sets whose only copy is Redis, `add` / `remove` / `put` / `clear`, and when a set belongs in a `Cache<K, Set<E>>` instead
- [Keeping Data Fresh](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/freshness): write then invalidate, `invalidate` vs `put`, batch and versioned writes, `TransactionalInvalidator`, `ExternalInvalidator`, choosing lifetimes, refresh-ahead, Redis down during a write
- [JoinCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/join-cache): `@JoinCacheable` read-only views over two caches, `@EnableCoCache(joinCaches = [...])`
- [Spring Cache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/spring-cache): `CoCacheSpringCacheManager`, `@Cacheable(sync = true)`, the sync check, transactions, loads inside a transaction, `DegradingCacheErrorHandler`
- [Async API](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/async): `cache.async()`, `AsyncCacheLoader`, threads and executors, `load-timeout`, exceptions and cancellation, Spring Cache `retrieve`
- [Kotlin Coroutines](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/coroutines): `cache.suspending()` on every type, `SuspendingCacheLoader` and `suspendingLoader`, loader context and dispatchers, cancellation, re-entry
- [Testing](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/testing): memory backend in `@SpringBootTest`, `ManualClock`, `InMemoryBackend` unit tests, `HookedBackend` fault injection
- [Native Images](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/native): Spring AOT and GraalVM native images, the hints the starter registers (proxies, SpEL roots, Jackson bindings), and the hints you provide (spec-cache codecs, custom codecs, SpEL beyond the root object)
- [Configuration Reference](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/configuration): every `cocache.*` property with type, default and unit; three-layer merge (`cocache.defaults` below the declaration, `cocache.overrides` that only tighten, `cocache.caches.[name]`); which keys apply to which type; durations need units, sentinels `forever` / `off` / `unlimited`; library locks; eviction check; effective-policy report
- [Deployment](https://cocache.ahoo.me/operations/): Redis versions and topologies, maxmemory-policy, TLS, channel modes, sizing, rolling deploys, key layout, ACLs
- [Observability](https://cocache.ahoo.me/operations/observability): every `cocache.*` meter and alerts, the `cocache` health indicator, the actuator endpoint (inspect and invalidate one key), logs
- [Troubleshooting](https://cocache.ahoo.me/operations/troubleshooting): runbooks and the external invalidation protocol
- [Upgrading from 6.x](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/upgrade): the cutover, type mapping, API, behavior, configuration keys, ACL, wire format, SPI and TCK changes
- [Changelog](https://cocache.ahoo.me/guide/changelog): releases

## Design

- [Architecture](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/): goals, modules, data model, runtime and Spring wiring
- [Consistency](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/consistency): leases, invalidation stamps, read/write paths, failure modes, guarantees
- [Extending CoCache](https://cocache.ahoo.me/architecture/extending): `CoherenceBackend` SPI and the `cocache-test` TCK
- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/CoCache/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): normative design and invariants (Chinese)
